concepts.def: Checking whether two items are equal or ordered.
Exchange the position of two items.
One complete sweep through the list.

walkthroughs.body_html: List of 8 items takes up to 3 comparisons (log2 8 = 3). List of 32 takes up to 5. Each comparison halves what's left.
Worst case for n items = n comparisons. Best case = 1 (first item). Average ≈ n/2 if target is present.
